And then there's visibility for the managers leading these teams.
Managers can have dashboards that show what's happening across their teams at a glance.
How many are waiting on the customer?
How much work does each agent have?
Are requests being answered within the expected time?
And are they being resolved within the expected time?
That visibility gives managers something we don't always have today: a clear picture of the work while it's happening.
It can help identify bottlenecks, workload issues, and opportunities to move resources where they're needed.
It can also help answer questions that are difficult to answer when the work is spread across an inbox.
How much work is the team actually receiving?
Is one person carrying most of the workload?
Are there certain types of requests taking significantly longer than others?
And are we meeting the service expectations we've set?
BoldDesk gives team leaders the information to actually see those things.
